Behold, the Magnum Opus begins here! You have finally crafted the legendary Philosopher's Stone, the undisputed starting point of great alchemy.

With this mystical artifact in your possession, the rigid laws of nature bend to your will. It allows you to perform basic transmutations, converting abundant, everyday materials into the scarce resources you desperately need to expand your industrial empire.

But its power does not end there. The Stone possesses immense thermodynamic potential. By channeling the latent energy of coal and other combustible fuels, you can direct intense heat into substances that require calcination, effectively smelting items on the go without ever needing to place down a furnace. Furthermore, it grants you the ability to manipulate matter directly in the physical world, shifting the very elements of the earth—like dirt and stone—beneath your feet with a simple catalyst.

The ancient alchemists' dream of turning ordinary stone into shimmering gold is no longer a myth—it has been realized right in the palm of your hands. Use it wisely, for this is merely your first step into the boundless realm of Equivalent Exchange!
